title: Bill Belichick on Louisville-UNC brawl: "That's not what we're here for"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bill Belichick on Louisville-UNC brawl: "That's not what we're here for"
sources.description: Saturday's game between Louisville and North Carolina ended in a brawl, sparked apparently by the Tar Heels being a little too aggressive in defending a victory-formation play.
